body:
GitHub release-asset 503/504 responses previously exhausted Gitleaks retries quickly and failed actionlint immediately. Both pinned installers now retry all curl errors within a 600-second retry window, cap each transfer at 60 seconds, and report the asset, last HTTP status and curl exit code on final failure. Version pins, checksums, upstream URLs, workflows, cache keys and job shape are unchanged.

Validation: each actual installer recovered from local HTTP 503, 503, 200 using its real checksum-pinned archive (3 requests, exit 0). Against persistent 504s, each made 121 requests and exited 22 after about 600.8 seconds with the archive name and last HTTP 504, installing no binary. No shortened budget or product test override was used. bash -n passed for the installers and bootstrap caller; actionlint passed all six workflows; candidate and evidence secret scans found no leaks.

Verify run 42476381817 is still in progress on exact candidate fd6d971af46b3aa88a8f6eb649153002a605e5a4 after five polls at five-minute intervals. Product is PUSHED, pending Verify and the fleet publication/landing gates. Complete receipts are published separately on evidence/fv-base-asset-retry-1.
